name: How to Add Page Numbers to a PDF Free
description: Add Arabic, Roman, or alphabetic page numbers to any existing PDF — free, no upload, processed locally in your browser.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based PDF page numbering tool, no upload required

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. The file loads in your browser — nothing is uploaded to any server.

step.name: Configure the numbering
step.text: Choose number format (Arabic 1,2,3 / Roman i,ii,iii / Alphabetic A,B,C), position (top or bottom, left/center/right), starting number, and whether to skip the first page. Optionally add a prefix or suffix for 'Page 1 of 20' style.

step.name: Apply and download
step.text: Click 'Add Page Numbers'. Page numbers are embedded as clean text on each page. The PDF downloads immediately — original content is unchanged.
